thread:
incident-bot: PAGE @oncall-ecs: spike in 5xxs from canary deployment (service=inference-api, region=eu-west). auto-rollback attempted and failed.

oncall-ecs: grabbing it, paging SRE

sre-amy: I'll take lead. Which rollout is this?

deploy-bot: Canary rollout id: canary-2026-03-17 (model_variant_alpha). Auto-rollback logged error: "rollout-controller: routing mapping missing for variant". logs:
```
ERROR rollout-controller: reconcile: mapping for model_variant_alpha -> route not found
failed auto-rollback attempt id=rb-6132220001
```

jordan: That mapping was in the configmap that infra rotated last night.

oncall-ecs: Initiating manual traffic evacuation from canary -> stable. Running flag command:
`flagsvc set model_variant_alpha --env=prod --percent=0 --reason="emergency-drain"`

maya: Support reports small number of malformed responses and increased tail latency. Ticket INC-9901 opened. Suggest immediate drain + rollback.

sre-amy: Plan from runbook: 1) block canary traffic, 2) manual rollback to previous revision, 3) evict session caches, 4) run synthetic check against top customers. Proceeding.

luca: Will perform rollback. Executing:
`kubectl -n prod rollout undo deployment/model-serving --to-revision=78`

deploy-bot: Manual rollback job started (job id rb-6132220015). Monitoring pod state...

sre-amy: Evicting KV session caches pinned to canary:
`curl -s -X POST https://ops.internal/evict -d '{"key_prefix":"sess:model_variant_alpha"}'`

oncall-ecs: Flagsvc reports model_variant_alpha traffic now 0%. Prometheus shows 5xxs dropping.

deploy-bot: Rollback completed successfully. Current deployment at revision 78. Canary pods terminated.

sre-amy: Running verification suite (10 probes across eu/us). Results: malformed responses 0/10, latency back to normal.

maya: Support confirms 3 users affected, tickets updated, informed customers. No enterprise customers impacted so far.

jordan: Any migration/schema changes tied to the canary? Need to ensure backward compatibility.

sre-amy: No DB changes in this rollout; only model artifact and routing metadata. Cache eviction and undo should clear in-flight sessions. Will monitor for 30 minutes.

oncall-ecs: 5xx rate down from 9% -> 0.5% within 7 mins. Traces with model_variant_alpha tag dropped to near zero.

incident-bot: NOTE: auto-rollback failed due to routing-config mismatch; manual rollback and flag drain succeeded. Incident recorded for postmortem.

jordan: Action items: (1) postmortem owner @jordan, (2) infra to add guardrail so configmap rotations validate rollout-controller mappings before rotation @maya, (3) add pre-rollback check: ensure routing mapping exists before attempting automated rollback @sre-amy.

luca: I'll attach rollback job logs to the incident ticket.

sre-amy: Handing back to oncall and closing pager. Monitoring window remains open for 30m.

oncall-ecs: Acknowledged. Marking resolved in PD.

jordan: Thanks all — schedule quick follow-up to sync on fix and customer comms. :thumbsup:
